goal: Avoid marking healthy peer addresses as terrible when only local connectivity to their network fails
Keep gossip and relay active for peers on networks that are only locally unreachable
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing connection logs across networks on master and PR branch (naiyoma)
Resolved concern that unreachable network addresses could stay indefinitely in addrman (stratospher)
Concept approval without stated reasons (fjahr, brunoerg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes false peer penalization when a node loses reachability on one network but not others
Stops nodes from incorrectly demoting valid remote peers and halting their address relay
